output.summary: Rhizomatous herbaceous perennial native to cold Northern Hemisphere regions across parts of Europe, northern Asia and North America. It grows in ponds and swamps, with nearly heart-shaped leaves, yellow-green flower spikes and clusters of red berries; the fresh plant is very poisonous, but its rhizomes are edible after boiling or drying.
